description: This file defines a class ExportChartsCommand for exporting chart data, including methods for generating filenames, content, and exporting related datasets and tags within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: ExportChartsCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting chart models, including related datasets and tags, with configurable options for tag export.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for the chart export based on the chart's name and ID.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Creates the YAML content for the chart export, including metadata, parameters, version, dataset UUID, and tags if enabled.

methods.name: _export
methods.description: Generator function that yields filename-content pairs and related dataset and tag exports.
